entity_schema.$comment: Every generated entity file is a flat JSON array of objects with EXACTLY this shape. Zero translated UI text inside entity files.
entity_schema.id: string  — derived: '<prefix>_<slug>' where slug = basename of legacy data-audio attr (diacritics already stripped)
entity_schema.term: string — native-target text (Romanian for ro entities, English for en entities)
entity_schema.ipa: string|null — ONLY available in archive/english/alphabet.html; null elsewhere

translations.en: string|null — English gloss (omit key when null)
translations.es: string|null — bonus pivot columns from vocabulary.html; keep but never render in v1

entity_schema.audio: string|null — R2 URL: 'https://media.verbologic.com/audio/<lang>/<id>.mp3'; null when queued for TTS

actions.section_headings: h2/h3 with id attr -> store on entity as 'category' (e.g. 'greetings-courtesy', 'home-objects')

actions.$comment: One row yields up to 3 entity records: question_<slug>, question_<slug>_a1, question_<slug>_a2 — audio maps 1:1, hence 135 files for 60 rows.

actions.audio: NONE — all entities get audio:null and are added to tts_queue

column_map.3: contrastive_note_ro (English approximation -> ALSO mirror to locales/ro.json)

actions.audio: NONE — all entities get audio:null and are added to tts_queue

column_map.5: contrastive_note_ro ('Română' col + surrounding prose: 'like the ts in cats…')

actions.$comment: L1=ro track. Contrastive prose goes to locales/ro.json under contrastive.letter_en_<slug>.note

outputs.public/data/locales/en.json: Generic UI chrome in English: play button labels, table headers ('Romanian', 'English Translation'), section titles, progress labels. NO contrastive content.
outputs.public/data/locales/ro.json: 1) Same generic chrome translated to Romanian. 2) Native-relative contrastive notes keyed 'contrastive.<entity_id>.note' sourced from romanian/alphabet.html 'English Approximation' column and english/alphabet.html 'Română' column + prose. 3) English-track pedagogy text ('Descoperă English', lesson descriptions).

actions.$comment: Contrastive notes are L1-relative explanations (Romanian explaining English sounds, or English analogies for Romanian sounds) — they are locale data, never entity data.

Copy (never move, never git-commit) each legacy MP3 to ./media/audio preserving the R2 key layout. Derive entity_id = <prefix>_<slug>. Set entity.audio = 'https://media.verbologic.com/' + r2_target_path.
0-byte corrupt file, referenced by zero HTML pages. Do not copy to media staging.
Entities keep audio:null until the TTS batch is produced and uploaded to R2.

validation_rules: Every entity 'audio' URL must be https://media.verbologic.com/audio/<lang>/<id>.mp3 and the file must exist under ./media/audio with that key, OR be listed in media/tts_queue.json with audio:null
Entity files contain zero UI strings (no 'Play', no button labels) — those live only in locales/*.json
ro_vocabulary.json must contain ~160 entities across 12 'category' values
en_alphabet.json must contain 82 entities, every one with non-null 'ipa'
Total copied MP3s under ./media/audio must equal 463
No file under ./media/ may be git-tracked; add './media/' to .gitignore
